description: Hyperliquid TWAP orders, one row per status line, newest first. A line is a status CHANGE (`activated`, `waitingForTrigger`, then `finished`, `terminated` or `stopped`), not a slice fill: `executed_size` and `executed_notional_usd` are the cumulative totals when the line was written. Rejected placements (`error`) are hidden unless `status=error`. Across all wallets the window defaults to the last 24 hours and is at most 31 days; with `wallet` or `twap_id` neither applies. `order=asc` follows the feed: pass each `nextCursor` back and stop on an empty page. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/twaps; with `wallet` it is GET /v1/hyperliquid/wallets/{address}/twaps (one feed: the cursors are interchangeable).

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, verbatim. It pins the call that returned it: send the same `order`, filters, `start` and `end` again, or the call is refused.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound. Default: now. A window wider than 31 days is refused unless `wallet` or `twap_id` is given.

order.description: `desc` (default, newest first) or `asc`, oldest first: the mode for FOLLOWING the feed. Pass each `nextCursor` back verbatim and stop on an EMPTY page, not on a null cursor (an `asc` page with rows always carries one). A row written late with an older key is not seen by a poller already past it: re-read a small overlap with `start`.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound. Default: the 24 hours before `end`, unless `wallet` or `twap_id` is given.

status.description: One status. Default: every status except `error` (a rejected placement, not an order); `error` shows those rows.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. Omit for all symbols.

twap_id.description: One TWAP id: every status line of that TWAP. 0 (the default) = every TWAP. Max 9007199254740991.

wallet.description: One wallet, 0x followed by 40 hex characters, any case. With it (or `twap_id`) there is no default window and no 31-day cap.

title: Hyperliquid Twaps
